title: Preserve provider-specific event, derivatives and ETF scopes; model SBI as a multi-rail XRP distribution and stablecoin ecosystem
decision: Record Bitquery's nine-chain and TRM/Reuters ten-chain incident counts separately; do not force consensus until wallet/chain-level datasets are reconciled.
Use Bitquery's 06:43 UTC XRP receiver balance only as a cutoff-limited observation; Bithomp's 07:23 UTC capture is later, and no subsequent receiver movement is verified in this run.
Keep TradRadar 07:50 UTC and Liqwall 01:32 UTC as separate derivatives panels; do not average open interest or liquidation values across different exchange coverage and cutoffs.

Treat Alpha Finance's October 29 +$8.4M as a completed five-fund secondary tracker snapshot, while CryptoETF.today's +$7.1M is explicitly partial 2/5. Reconcile both to issuer files before model admission.

Keep SBI's XRP card/bond rewards, Bitbank market, JPYSC reserve assets, USDC/RLUSD distribution, OUSD PoC, BlackRock MMF MOU and trust merger as separate economic channels; do not aggregate into XRP capital demand.
Maintain forecast status NOT_ISSUED until synchronized, leakage-safe and calibrated fixed-horizon evaluation passes.
rationale: The refreshed Bitquery page revised the broader incident to nine chains and $2.7B frozen/rescued while retaining 233.5M XRP at the receiver as of 06:43 UTC; Reuters reports TRM's ten-chain attribution.
TradRadar's 07:50 panel is the freshest provider-specific XRP derivatives snapshot in this capture; Liqwall's earlier data demonstrate why venue coverage and timestamp alignment matter.
ETF flow trackers disagree in completeness, not necessarily in final flow: Alpha shows five funds, CryptoETF.today only two.
SBI's completed Bitbank acquisition and XRP incentives coexist with JPYSC/OUSD, BlackRock MMF and USDC/RLUSD distribution, showing a multi-rail strategy rather than a single XRP-centric system.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not interpret the 9-versus-10 chain discrepancy as evidence of another theft chain without wallet-level reconciliation.
Do not treat negative TrackWhale flow as voluntary outflow; the seven-day panel is incident-contaminated.
Do not average TradRadar and Liqwall OI/liquidation data.
Do not treat CryptoETF.today's 2/5 flow as the final October 29 daily ETF flow.
Do not convert SBI JPYSC issuance, lending applications, short-JGB backing, tokenized-MMF MOU or XRP incentives into one aggregate XRP demand number.
required_next_evidence: Retrieve Binance's official October 1 address-download payload and crosswalk the five XRPL source accounts and XRP-BF2 backing address.
Obtain a receiver balance/transaction observation later than 07:23 UTC and monitor for transfers, swaps or exchange deposits.
Reconcile the 9-versus-10 chain count at wallet level using the underlying TRM and Bitquery address sets.
Build synchronized venue-level XRP spot/perpetual OI, funding, liquidation and order-book data.
Reconcile October 29 ETF flows to issuer holdings and creation/redemption files.
Build a historical Bitbank XRP/JPY spread/depth/volume series around the October 1 SBI acquisition.
Track SBI's JPYSC/OUSD PoC, BlackRock tokenized-MMF MOU and trust merger for actual production/collateral evidence.
